title: how
goal: how로 방법·상태를 묻고, how much / many / old / long / often / far로 숫자와 정도를 물어볼 수 있어요.

points.title: how = 어떻게 / 어때요
points.body: 방법을 물을 때(How do you get to work? 출근 어떻게 해요?)와 상태·느낌을 물을 때(How was your day? 하루 어땠어요?) 써요.

points.title: 호주식 인사 How are you going?
points.body: How are you?와 같은 뜻으로 호주에서는 How are you going?이나 How's it going?을 정말 많이 써요. 대답은 Good, thanks!

points.title: how + 형용사 = 얼마나 ~?
points.body: how old(몇 살), how long(얼마나 오래 / 길게), how often(얼마나 자주), how far(얼마나 멀리)처럼 뒤에 말을 붙여 정도를 물어요.

points.title: how much와 how many
points.body: 가격이나 셀 수 없는 양은 how much(How much is this?), 하나 둘 셀 수 있는 것의 개수는 how many + 복수명사(How many housemates?)예요.

points.title: 순서는 똑같아요
points.body: How + be동사 + 주어? 또는 How + do / does / did + 주어 + 동사원형? 앞에서 배운 질문 순서 그대로예요.

formula: How + do / does / did + 주어 + 동사원형? (방법)

mistakes.why: 사람처럼 하나 둘 셀 수 있는 것의 수는 how many로 물어요.

mistakes.right: How do you get to work?
mistakes.why: how 뒤에도 do가 필요해요. '출근하다'는 get to work가 자연스러워요.

mistakes.wrong: How long time will you stay?
mistakes.why: how long 자체가 '얼마나 오래'라서 time을 붙이지 않아요.

examples.en: How are you going? – Good, thanks!
How was your first day at work?
How do you get to work? – By tram.
How many housemates do you have?
How long will you stay in Australia?
How often do you go to the beach?
How far is the station from here?

quiz.sentence: ___ was the party? – It was great!

quiz.why: 셀 수 있는 eggs(복수) → how many

quiz.sentence: How ___ you get to the farm? – By car.
quiz.why: 일반동사 get의 과거 질문 → did + 동사원형

quiz.answer: How often do you go to the gym?
choices: How often do you go to the gym?
How often you go to the gym?
How often do you goes to the gym?
How many do you go to the gym?
quiz.why: 빈도는 How often + do + 주어 + 동사원형
가격은 How much, these apples는 복수라서 are

choices: How much long is the flight?

quiz.why: 사람 수는 how many, people은 이미 복수

quiz.answer: How do you spell your name?
choices: How do you spell your name?
How do you spells your name?
How does you spell your name?

quiz.answer: How far is your share house from the city?
choices: How far is your share house from the city?
How far your share house is from the city?
How far does your share house from the city?
How long far is your share house from the city?
